# <span id="aanchor446"></span> Configure Report/Export Scheduling

During new implementations or installation in a new environment, you may need to configure the application to enable report and export scheduling. Scheduling provides the ability to create recurring jobs that can email reports/exports to one or more contacts, print to a network printer, or save the report/export files to a network location.

The administrator will need the following account credentials:

- FLOWCAL services account created specifically for the FLOWCAL services to connect to the database and process data. (See: [Create Users](Create%20Users.md))
- Company email account for emailing from FLOWCAL. This is the email address recipients will see on emails originating from FLOWCAL.
- Company network account with elevated privileges, which will allow the Reports service to create report/export files at different network locations based on the user’s schedule settings.

<div class="procedure">

To configure the ability to schedule or email:

1.  Confirm the FLOWCAL services account is set up within the Service Login section of the Service Configuration screen. (See: [Install &amp; Configure Services](Install%20%26%20Configure%20Services.md))
2.  Confirm the company email account credentials are configured within the Email Information section of the Report Scheduler Configuration.
3.  Install the Reports service (FcSrvReports.exe).
4.  Within the Microsoft Windows Services console, right-click the reports service and configure the logon to use the designated company network account so that the service can write to the network.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 554;height: 330;" />

</div>

The Report Scheduler Configuration screen is used to set up necessary information for emailing and printing. Failure to properly set up the system will result in reports not being sent correctly. The report service will identify any errors; these error messages will then be available in the Report Scheduler Status screen to help troubleshoot the problems.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Email Information">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Email Information</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Email Information">

<div class="procedure">

To configure email:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Report Scheduler** \> **Configuration**.

2.  Click the **Edit** button.

3.  Enter the SMTP server name.

    The FLOWCAL reports service uses SMTP rather than MAPI to send emails because MAPI is prone to stalling. The SMTP server name (e.g., smtp.companyname.com) can also be an IP address. The Reports service also supports using SSL/TSL authentication. Check the **Enable SSL/TSL** checkbox and enter the port that is required (usually found through the user's Exchange server). If SMTP does not require this level of authentication, leave the checkbox and **Port** field blank.

4.  Enter your username, password and password confirmation.

    When sending email through the FLOWCAL Reports service, the service will try to connect with the username and password provided. When first entering the username, the password should be specified if there is one. After saving the changes, if you open the screen again, the SMTP server name and username will display, but the password will not. You do not need to re-enter the password. It is not displayed for security reasons, but it is saved.

5.  Enter the sender email address (the full email address for the username that will display in outgoing emails). Not doing so may result in an error message regarding an unknown sender.

6.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Output Printers">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Output Printers</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Output Printers">

<div class="procedure">

When creating report or export schedules to print, FLOWCAL will display the printers that have been defined within Output Printers.

To configure printers:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Report Scheduler** \> **Configuration**.

2.  Click the **Edit** button.

3.  Click **Edit Output Printers**.

4.  The printers available for selection will appear on the left. Double-click a printer to add it to the Selected Printers list.

    Only printers known to the local server will display. If you need to access another printer on the network, the printer must first be installed on the local server.

5.  Click **OK**.

6.  The printers will now be available from Report Scheduling.

    The functionality behind the **Print Orientation** button is no longer supported.

</div>

</div>
